```yaml
name: Private Proof Benchmark & Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'scripts/benchmark-private-e2e.ts'
      - 'benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/**'
      - '.github/workflows/private-proof-benchmark-pages.yml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  benchmark:
    name: Run Private Proof Benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Private Proof E2E Benchmark
        run: npm run benchmark:private:e2e
        env:
          NODE_PATH: ./node_modules

      - name: Upload Benchmark Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/
          retention-days: 30

  deploy-pages:
    name: Deploy Benchmark Pages
    needs: benchmark
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Benchmark Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
